Porsche SE Invests in Reusable Rocket Maker Stoke Space
Porsche Automobil Holding SE has made its second investment in the space sector with a low double-digit million dollar deal for a stake in reusable rocket maker, Stoke Space.

Stoke Space is developing a reusable two-stage launch vehicle similar to that of Elon Musk's SpaceX. It hopes to compete with the market leader, saying there is significant excess demand for rocket launches. The first flight of its Nova launch vehicle is planned for early 2027.
The holding company, which is Volkswagen's largest shareholder, said Tuesday the investment was made as part of a 1 billion dollar financing round.
OpenAI Chief Executive Sam Altman has explored investing in Stoke Space, The Wall Street Journal reported last December.
Porsche SE previously invested in Isar Aerospace.
